title: Jury Management Solution (JMS) System (Presolicitation)
agency: Administrative Office of the U.S. Courts
description: Pre-solicitation notice for a web-based Jury Management System for the Administrative Office of the U.S. Courts. The solicitation is unrestricted and not set aside for small business; the Judiciary is not subject to the FAR small business regulations. The AO plans a single-award IDIQ for a commercial off-the-shelf web-based jury management solution that supports selecting, managing and tracking jurors, performs financial and statistical calculations, and interfaces with the Judiciary's financial management system, Momentum. The draft solicitation USCA27R0009 gives requirements and evaluation criteria. The due time is listed as TBD.
